description: Search lawyers in a German city (or around a 5-digit postcode, 10 km; around a smaller place, 25 km) by area of law and language, or by the name of a lawyer or a firm. `area` is one of the 24 Fachanwalt areas (for example 'Arbeitsrecht', 'Familienrecht', 'Miet- und Wohnungseigentumsrecht'); lawyers holding that Fachanwalt title come first. `name` finds a lawyer by first and last name or by surname alone, or a firm by its name; umlaut spellings (Müller, Mueller, Muller) and one typo per word are tolerated, exact spellings rank first. With `name`, only the matches are returned, narrowed by city, area and language when given. Give `city`, `name` or both. Returns register-verified entries with contact data and profile links. In-house lawyers (Syndikusrechtsanwälte) are not listed: they may advise only their employer. Nor are lawyers whose register entry says they are no longer a member of the bar.

area.description: Area of law, ideally one of the 24 Fachanwalt areas. Values: Verwaltungsrecht; Steuerrecht; Arbeitsrecht; Sozialrecht; Familienrecht; Strafrecht; Insolvenz- und Sanierungsrecht; Versicherungsrecht; Medizinrecht; Miet- und Wohnungseigentumsrecht; Verkehrsrecht; Bau- und Architektenrecht; Erbrecht; Transport- und Speditionsrecht; Gewerblicher Rechtsschutz; Handels- und Gesellschaftsrecht; Urheber- und Medienrecht; Informationstechnologierecht; Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht; Agrarrecht; Internationales Wirtschaftsrecht; Vergaberecht; Migrationsrecht; Sportrecht.

city.description: City name (Berlin, München, ...), any other German place (searched 25 km around it) or a 5-digit postcode (10 km around it).

language.description: Language the lawyer speaks, German or English name (Englisch, English, Türkisch, ...).

name.description: Name of a lawyer ('Daniel Schwartz', 'Schwartz') or of a firm ('Gleiss Lutz').
